sn51.26:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti.
sn51.26:1.8: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave catunnaṃ iddhipādānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā satta phalā sattānisaṃsā pāṭikaṅkhā.
sn51.26:2.3: no ce diṭṭheva dhamme paṭikacca aññaṃ ārādheti atha maraṇakāle aññaṃ ārādheti
sn51.26:2.4: no ce diṭṭheva dhamme paṭikacca aññaṃ ārādheti no ce maraṇakāle aññaṃ ārādheti. atha pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā antarāparinibbāyī hoti upahaccaparinibbāyī hoti asaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti uddhaṃsoto hoti akaniṭṭhagāmī.
sn51.26:2.5: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave catunnaṃ iddhipādānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā ime satta phalā sattānisaṃsā pāṭikaṅkhāti.
